name: cold-outreach-playbook
description: Turn strangers into customers with value-first cold outreach. Ask five quick questions (or paste a product URL), and it does the rest: researches your ICP online — motivation, what they care about, the problem in their words — designs the best attention hook (grab + gift), and writes the full sequence where the first two messages deliver more value than competitors charge for. Plus channel copy, cadence, metrics, and compliance.
